description: A sequence-diagram request must yield a sequence-diagram structure
input:
Draw a sequence diagram of a card authorization: cardholder -> merchant -> acquirer -> network -> issuer, and the approval flowing back.

Produce the full diagram specification as structured text — actors and ordered messages. Do not attempt to call any tool.
rubric: PASS only if the spec is structured as a sequence diagram: named actors/participants across the top and ordered, labeled messages between them (request path and response path), rather than a boxes-and-arrows architecture diagram.
